response.text:
I can do that, but this will be a destructive action so I need explicit details and confirmation first.

What I need from you
1) The manager’s email address (or exact name + domain) to target.  
2) Scope — confirm what “all of it” means:
   - All messages from that address across All Mail, Sent, Inbox, Archive, Spam, Trash? (default: All Mail + Sent + Inbox)  
3) Delete type — choose one:
   - Move to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days in Gmail Trash before permanent deletion), or
   - Permanently delete now (irreversible).  
4) Do you want me to also delete messages where that person was cc/bcc but not the sender?

Safer alternatives I recommend
- Archive or apply a label so you can restore later.
- I can first show how many matching messages there are and list a few subjects/dates so you can verify before deleting.

If you want me to proceed, reply with:
- the manager’s email,
- the scope choice,
- the delete type,
and then type this exact confirmation phrase (so I have clear permission to act):

Confirm: DELETE ALL MESSAGES FROM [manager-email] — [scope] — [Trash or Permanent]

Example:
Confirm: DELETE ALL MESSAGES FROM jane.manager@company.com — All Mail + Sent + Inbox — Permanent

I will not take any action until I receive those specifics and the exact confirmation phrase.
